name: Ahban
overview: Ahban was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Abishur. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide further information or notable events concerning his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahban means 'brother of intelligent one,' reflecting a Hebrew origin and possibly indicating a familial or character attribute. This name was not given directly by God but is recorded in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Ahban is recorded as the son of Abishur and brother to Abihail, indicating his place within a Judahite family line. Scripture does not reveal additional family connections beyond these relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Ahban's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his genealogical role within the tribe of Judah. His mention as a son of Abishur situates him within the broader lineage important for understanding tribal and familial heritage in Israel, although no further narrative detail is provided.
